productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Adventure through the magical rainforest with Dora, Boots, and friends—but watch out for Swiper the sneaky fox. ¡Vamonos! ¡Hola amigos! Join Dora, Boots, Map, Backpack and all their friends as they learn, play, and help each other in these seven fun-filled five-minute stories. productOnPage.descriptionMarkdown:
**_Yoto Says: Adventure through the magical rainforest with Dora, Boots, and friends—but watch out for Swiper the sneaky fox. ¡Vamonos!._**

¡Hola amigos! Join Dora, Boots, Map, Backpack and all their friends as they learn, play, and help each other in these seven fun-filled five-minute stories. Stop Big Red Chicken from floating away down a windy river, learn an awesome new dance with Boots, help find the Sun’s missing Pillow Cloud, and more! Adventure awaits!

Tracks included:

*   Big Red Chicken, Wake Up!
*   The Rainforest Ritmo
*   Wizzle Wozzle Woo
*   The Sleepy Sun
*   Friendaversary Adventure
*   Tres Leches Trouble
*   Bubble Trouble

yotoCreatorModal.body:
#### Who are Creators on Yoto?

Creators are independent audio makers bringing their original stories, games, songs and more to Yoto Cards. We hand-pick the best and freshest ideas — so every Creators Card meets the Yoto gold standard.

[Explore the Creators Collection](/creators/)

[Read Creator biographies](https://yoto.space/creator-profiles)
